authority: Owner explicitly authorized assistant reassessment on 2026-09-22; prior owner decisions remain in DEVELOPMENT.md.

before.claim: In human lung adenocarcinoma, AREG detection is higher in epithelial than in myeloid cells within the same donor: median 0.336 against 0.215, 11 donors, paired Wilcoxon p = 0.0020
before.analysis: trial E1 on GSE131907 (Kim et al. 2020), marker gates, deposited labels used only for a cross-check
before.limitations: High, and structurally different from every row above it: the donor is the unit, so this is the only tested claim in this folder.

after.claim: The epithelial-versus-myeloid AREG detection contrast in tumour lung is sensitive to annotation and molecule-depth standardization
after.analysis: Deposited-label comparison in 10 donors: medians 0.4591 versus 0.2715, all10 epithelial-higher, exact paired p = 0.001953. At the prespecified primary 1,000-UMI expected-detection budget: medians 0.1224 versus 0.0999, 6/10 epithelial-higher, median paired difference 0.0293, p = 0.130859. Sensitivities: 500 UMIs p0.322266; 2,000 UMIs p0.019531 with8/10 positive. Raw and cached detection agree in all16,064 selected cells.
after.limitations: The historical marker gate included many T/NK cells. Corrected annotation preserves unadjusted direction, but the primary molecule-standardized comparison does not establish a depth-independent hierarchy. Report all budgets; do not select the2,000-UMI result because it passes. Standardization changes the estimand. All16,064 cells remain at500 and1,000 UMIs; only2,000 UMIs excludes1,188 cells, while all10 donors remain; UMI capture reflects biology and technology. No result measures total tissue secretion, exclusive source or receptor activation. Failed significance is not biological absence.

before.claim: HBEGF in human lung adenocarcinoma is myeloid-dominant, by marker gate and by deposited subtype label alike (alveolar macrophages 0.712, CD163+CD14+ dendritic cells 0.655, against tumour state tS2 0.420 and matrix fibroblasts 0.087)
before.analysis: trials E1 T2 and E1b T6, two independent groupings of the same cells
before.limitations: High. It matches the published human emphasis and contradicts the mouse pattern in C6, so the Hbegf lead does not transfer across species unchanged.

after.claim: HBEGF in human lung adenocarcinoma is myeloid-dominant, by marker gate and by deposited subtype label alike (alveolar macrophages 0.712, CD163+CD14+ dendritic cells 0.655, against tumour state tS2 0.420 and matrix fibroblasts 0.087)
after.analysis: trials E1 T2 and E1b T6, two independent groupings of the same cells
after.limitations: High. It matches the published human emphasis and contradicts the mouse pattern in C6, so the Hbegf lead does not transfer across species unchanged. Annotation sensitivity on the same cells is not independent replication. The original E1 marker gate is not corroborating evidence for the stated major lineages; its composition is documented by the correction.

before.claim: A whole-resource ligand-receptor ranking on dissociated lung tissue reports transcript abundance rather than signalling: 11 of the top 15 epithelium-to-fibroblast pairs target CD44, with collagen, laminin and fibronectin ligands
before.analysis: trial C12 on GSE136831, 26 donors and 313 pairs, CellChat's resource and scoring through liana with permutations off
before.limitations: High as a methods result, and the one the trial actually produced. It also explains why naming a shortlist in advance, as the paper did, is defensible rather than a shortcut.

after.claim: In the corrected CellChatDB epithelial-to-fibroblast scan, 10 of the top 15 retained pairs target CD44
after.analysis: Post-audit correction: 22 donors, 312 retained pairs; FN1 to CD44 ranks first, and the historical abundance flag labels 11/15 top pairs (0.7333). Explicit deposited-epithelial senders exclude pericytes/SMC; target counts use Fibroblast/Myofibroblast. Mesothelial remains because the deposited category is epithelial.
after.limitations: The historical count of 11 CD44-targeting top pairs was based on broader senders and is superseded for epithelial interpretation. High matrix-pair prevalence is an expression-score property; this analysis does not determine whether those pairs signal.

before.claim: Some pair in CellChatDB outranks the AREG to EGFR axis from epithelium to fibroblast
before.analysis: trial C12: the ranking that would answer this failed its own pre-registered abundance guard, 11 of the top 15
before.limitations: Moderate. The discovery affordance that justified the trial produced matrix-to-CD44 pairs and nothing else.

after.claim: Several expression-derived pairs rank above AREG to EGFR in the corrected CellChatDB scan
after.analysis: AREG to EGFR has aggregate rank 7 of 312 retained pairs and donor-median rank 10.5; FN1 to CD44 ranks first across 22 eligible donors. These are descriptive rankings, not statistical evidence that another mechanism is superior.
after.limitations: The literal ranking is observed; functional superiority or communication remains not established. This separates the computational proposition from the historical biological gate.

before.claim: Among the five EGFR ligands, AREG ranks first in human fibrosis by CellChat's own resource and scoring, median rank 15.5 of 313 across 26 donors, with HBEGF second at 48.5
before.analysis: trial C12 T4, holding the receptor constant so the promiscuity effect the guard detects cannot apply
before.limitations: Moderate, and it vindicates the paper's choice of shortlist in a second species. Provisional because the guard's scope and the reading gloss disagreed about whether T4 could be read, which is disclosed as the fifth defect of that shape.

after.claim: AREG ranks first among the prespecified canonical EGFR ligands in corrected CellChatDB scoring
after.analysis: Corrected epithelial-to-fibroblast pass: 22 eligible donors, 312 retained pairs; AREG donor-median rank 10.5 and HBEGF 41.0, with exact-EGFR canonical order AREG, HBEGF, EREG, TGFA, BTC. Historical 26-donor ranks 15.5 and 48.5 remain in frozen C12 outputs.
after.limitations: Rank is conditional on sender/target definition, donor coverage and the prespecified canonical ligand list; it is not a comparison against every possible EGFR interaction or functional validation.

before.claim: Transcriptional downregulation of Epcam explains why the transitional state escapes an EpCAM-negative gate
before.analysis: trial C13 T1 on five libraries of GSE247505 and GSE316244: Epcam detection is equal or higher in the transitional state everywhere, and no depth half shows a deficit above 6.6 points
before.limitations: High for the contaminant story: it removes the simple explanation for claim C26 and leaves only post-transcriptional ones, which is where the shared-sheddase mechanism would sit.

after.claim: Transcriptional downregulation of Epcam explains why the transitional state escapes an EpCAM-negative gate
after.analysis: trial C13 T1 on five libraries of GSE247505 and GSE316244: Epcam detection is equal or higher in the transitional state everywhere, and no depth half shows a deficit above 6.6 points
after.limitations: Not established. The ten-point detection-deficit rule failed in companion epithelial states; mean normalized Epcam also increased in those states. These are descriptive observations against a broad average decrease in the sampled states. Neither transcription nor surface protein was measured in actual escaping sorted cells, so the proposed mechanism is unestablished rather than refuted.

before.claim: The transitional state expresses more Epcam than AT2 cells
before.analysis: trial C13: the observed gap is +0.02 to +0.09 while Epcam sits between 0.89 and 1.00 in both groups, and transitional cells are deeper in all five libraries
before.limitations: Moderate as a caution against reading the direction of a near-saturated detection difference.

after.claim: The transitional state expresses more Epcam than AT2 cells
after.analysis: trial C13: the observed detection gap is +0.02 to +0.09; Epcam detection spans 0.6456 to 0.9912 across the two groups in five evaluable libraries, and transitional cells are deeper in all five
after.limitations: Moderate as a caution against reading the direction of a near-saturated detection difference. Correction: the blanket 0.89–1.00 Epcam detection range omits evaluable Expt1_4dRFPr2 (0.6674 transitional versus 0.6456 AT2). Companion mean-expression differences are positive in all five evaluable libraries, but do not provide replicated inference about actual sorted contaminants.

before.claim: Any surface EpCAM dimming in these cells would have to be post-transcriptional
before.analysis: trial C13, as the space left by C85 rather than a positive finding
before.limitations: High as the precise statement of what the reanalysis can support, and the reason the flow experiment is the next step rather than more sequencing.

after.claim: Any surface EpCAM dimming in these cells would have to be post-transcriptional
after.analysis: trial C13, as the space left by C85 rather than a positive finding
after.limitations: Not established. Detection fractions cannot exclude every transcriptional mechanism; the stored mean-expression increases concern companion states, not actual sorted contaminants. Surface dimming itself and the proposed shedding mechanism were not measured. A surface assay and targeted perturbation would be needed.

before.claim: A whole-resource ligand-receptor scan on dissociated tissue always surfaces matrix pairs against promiscuous receptors
before.analysis: trial C14: holding cells, donors, compartments and method fixed and varying only the resource, the abundance guard fires in 1 of 5, with shares of 0.80, 0.40, 0.27, 0.20 and 0.20
before.limitations: High, and it is a self-correction: this repository asserted the generalisation after trial C12, and section 12 of the divergence document said so. Only CellChatDB behaves that way on this tissue.

after.claim: A whole-resource ligand-receptor scan on dissociated tissue always surfaces matrix pairs against promiscuous receptors
after.analysis: Corrected common 22-donor epithelial-to-fibroblast analysis: abundance-flag shares among top15 are 0.7333 CellChatDB, 0.3333 CellPhoneDB, and 0.1333 for consensus, ConnectomeDB2020 and iTALK. The universal assertion fails under the same frozen historical flag after source correction.
after.limitations: The refutation is limited to the universal ranking claim under this score/flag. It does not establish the absence of abundance bias in other resources or functional superiority of their top pairs.

before.claim: AREG ranks first among the EGFR ligands independently of which curated resource is used
before.analysis: trial C14 T3: first in all four resources that contain EGFR ligands, with the full order AREG, HBEGF, TGFA, EREG, BTC identical in three
before.limitations: High. Holding the receptor constant removes the curation effect, so the paper's choice of ligand survives a test of the database it was scored against.

after.claim: AREG ranks first among the prespecified canonical ligands with an exact EGFR receptor entry in all four resources where such eligible pairs remain
after.analysis: Corrected 22-donor analysis: AREG is first within the canonical exact-EGFR subset in CellChatDB, CellPhoneDB, ConnectomeDB2020 and iTALK. Lower ligand orders differ. Consensus encodes canonical ligands mainly through receptor complexes and requires a separate scope.
after.limitations: With a shared receptor and expression score, shared-ligand ordering is largely constrained by the same expression quantities. Resource agreement is candidate-list robustness, not independent biological validation or elimination of curation effects. Other exact-EGFR entries may outrank these canonical ligands.

before.claim: The head of a ligand-receptor ranking is curation-dependent: CellChatDB shares 0 of its top 15 with italk and 3 with cellphonedb, while the three non-CellChat resources agree at Jaccard 0.43 to 0.58
before.analysis: trial C14 T4
before.limitations: High as a caution for anyone reporting top hits from such a scan: the list is at least as much a property of the resource as of the tissue.

after.claim: Corrected ligand-receptor top rankings remain resource-dependent on a common epithelial/fibroblast donor set
after.analysis: CellChatDB shares 0 of its top15 with iTALK and 3 with CellPhoneDB after excluding mural senders and enforcing actual target floors. Full corrected pairwise overlaps and historical comparisons are saved; historical non-CellChat Jaccard figures are not reused.
after.limitations: Coverage, receptor-complex encoding and the candidate universe change together across resources. This is a conditional algorithm/resource comparison using shared donors, not biological replication.

before.claim: The consensus resource lacks EGFR-targeting pairs
before.analysis: trial C14: it returned none, but that resource names many receptors as complexes and a complex name will not match a plain string
before.limitations: Low. Recorded so the zero is not read as biology.

after.claim: The consensus resource lacks EGFR-targeting pairs
after.analysis: The exported consensus resource contains EGFR-targeting entries, including AREG to EGFR_ERBB2 and other canonical ligand complexes. AREG to EGFR_ERBB2 is scored in 7/22 eligible donors, below the 11-donor retention threshold; 25 other EGFR-component pairs survive. Absence from a retained exact-receptor list is not absence from the resource.
after.limitations: Resource membership, receptor representation, expression eligibility and cross-donor retention are distinct. The correction directly refutes the resource-absence claim; it does not establish receptor-complex activation.

before.claim: The AT2 identity programme's distal chromatin is lower in the labelled group than in matched random gene sets, in all three wells that reached the statistic
before.analysis: trial M3 under one instrument and the gene-set null: percentile 0.000, 0.007 and 0.000 of 300 matched sets, at -37.8, -18.3 and -15.5 per cent of reference accessibility
before.limitations: High as the branch's clearest direction, and it is the opposite of the reading M1e produced and M2 withdrew. **Three cautions this row previously omitted.** One of the three wells is the uninjured negative control and it shows the same direction at a LARGER effect than one of the two test wells, which is the signature of a statistic that is not specific to the label. M3's own readings file calls 2 of the three wells not computable or not established, so none is a clean positive. And two of the three are Cebpa-null, where the source paper reports the AT2 programme already reduced, so they are not independent wells. Row C151.

after.claim: The M3 AT2 distal-accessibility contrast is below its matched-gene-set null in three evaluable wells, including uninjured 7-week Cebpa mutant
after.analysis: trial M3 under one instrument and the gene-set null: percentile 0.000, 0.007 and 0.000 of 300 matched sets, at -37.8, -18.3 and -15.5 per cent of reference accessibility
after.limitations: Exploratory conditional accessibility contrast. The -37.8%, -18.3%, -15.5% readings subtract a matched-set null mean before dividing by reference accessibility; raw contrasts are -31.8%, -16.0%, -8.5%. The uninjured comparator is 7-week Cebpa mutant, so its response can be genuine genetic plasticity. No well passes all original gates. Reference-cell resampling does not estimate animal-level uncertainty, and accessibility loss does not establish arrest or reversibility. Prior owner retention is preserved in decision 30.

before.claim: In the infected Cebpa-mutant well, AT2 distal accessibility in the labelled group is -15.5 per cent of reference accessibility with an interval of -24.4 to -6.6
before.analysis: trial M3, reported but refused under rule R9 because that well's positive control did not fire
before.limitations: Moderate. A bound a rule refuses is still a number, and the next instrument should be sized against it rather than against the three-sigma floor trial M2 quoted, which understates the hidden effect.

after.claim: A biological-sample-level reduction in AT2 distal accessibility is established in the infected Cebpa-mutant transitional group
after.analysis: trial M3, reported but refused under rule R9 because that well's positive control did not fire
after.limitations: Not established at the biological-sample level. The -15.5% is a background-centered contrast relative to reference accessibility, not remaining accessibility. The -24.4 to -6.6 interval is calibrated by reference-only cell splits; it is neither an animal-level confidence interval nor all-source uncertainty for the effect. Prior owner retention is preserved in decision 30.

before.claim: Axin2-positive and Il1r1-positive AT2 cells overlap
before.analysis: England et al. 2025 report Axin2 specifically upregulated in the Il1r1-lineage sorted fraction and write that this suggests enrichment; it is one supplementary panel, bulk-sorted, at homeostasis only, with no contingency table
before.status: Descriptive only (owner retained 2026-09-22, decision 30, as a block, to revisit)
before.limitations: High and immediately actionable: it is the only direct evidence in the field, the deposit GSE247505 is already held here, and the claim has never been asked with the mouse as the unit or after injury

after.claim: Axin2-positive and Il1r1-positive AT2 cells overlap
after.analysis: England et al. 2025 report Axin2 specifically upregulated in the Il1r1-lineage sorted fraction and write that this suggests enrichment; it is one supplementary panel, bulk-sorted, at homeostasis only, with no contingency table
after.limitations: Bulk Axin2 enrichment in an Il1r1-lineage sorted population is a descriptive association. It does not quantify same-cell current Axin2/Il1r1 overlap or joint responsiveness; lineage history and current transcript are different measurements. No assertion that this is the only evidence in the field is retained without a dated search. Prior block retention remains in decision 30.

before.claim: Axin2 or Il1r1 transcript detection can stand in for the lineage reporters in droplet single-cell data
before.analysis: measured on Choi's own deposit GSE145031: Axin2 detected in 4.6, 4.3 and 5.6 per cent of AT2-lineage cells and Il1r1 in 5.8, 7.1 and 7.1 per cent, both at about one UMI per positive cell. Nabhan's own supplement also concedes the reporter does not label all Axin2-positive cells
before.status: Refuted (owner retained 2026-09-22, decision 30, as a block, to revisit)
before.limitations: High, and it is the same shape as row C124 in the neighbouring branch: a population defined by a method that transcript counting cannot reproduce. At one molecule per positive cell a per-cell call is a Poisson coin flip

after.claim: Axin2 or Il1r1 transcript detection can stand in for the lineage reporters in droplet single-cell data
after.analysis: measured on Choi's own deposit GSE145031: Axin2 detected in 4.6, 4.3 and 5.6 per cent of AT2-lineage cells and Il1r1 in 5.8, 7.1 and 7.1 per cent, both at about one UMI per positive cell. Nabhan's own supplement also concedes the reporter does not label all Axin2-positive cells
after.limitations: Sparse current transcripts are not validated substitutes for historical lineage or activity reporters. The quoted 4–7% range belongs to GSE145031; GSE310539 Il1r1 detection is 19.3–29.8% in the RQ figure table. No paired reporter/transcript gold-standard comparison here estimates sensitivity or specificity, so general substitution is unestablished rather than quantitatively disproved. Prior block retention remains in decision 30.

before.claim: Locus-level chromatin accessibility is less sparse than the transcript for Axin2 and Il1r1, so a chromatin route escapes the floor that kills the transcript route
before.analysis: feasibility measurement on GSE310539 and GSE247130: at least one of Axin2's 15 to 16 linked peaks is detected in 22.1 and 39.4 per cent of cells against a transcript detected in 5.3 and 3.8 per cent, a gain of 4.1 and 10.4 fold. Three controls order correctly in both deposits: Sftpc (universal transcript, 2 peaks) is worse, Etv5 is even, Lgr5 shows the largest gain
before.status: Descriptive only (owner retained 2026-09-22, decision 30, as a block, to revisit)
before.limitations: High as the one route this branch opened rather than closed. It is cheap, the data are already local and the machinery is built by the neighbouring branch

after.claim: At least one linked Axin2 peak is detected more often than its transcript in the tested multiome wells
after.analysis: feasibility measurement on GSE310539 and GSE247130: at least one of Axin2's 15 to 16 linked peaks is detected in 22.1 and 39.4 per cent of cells against a transcript detected in 5.3 and 3.8 per cent, a gain of 4.1 and 10.4 fold. Three controls order correctly in both deposits: Sftpc (universal transcript, 2 peaks) is worse, Etv5 is even, Lgr5 shows the largest gain
after.limitations: The union of several linked peaks increases detection relative to one transcript. This is an assay-feasibility observation, not evidence that locus accessibility identifies current Wnt activity, improves biological specificity or solves the same-cell responsiveness question. Prior block retention remains in decision 30.

before.claim: A graded locus statistic, the fraction of a locus's peaks detected correlated across cells, has real sensitivity to co-accessibility where a binary one has none
before.analysis: trial A1c against A1b: the binary form detected nothing anywhere, while the graded form clears on Etv5 against Abca3 at z = +3.55 and on Krt8 against Krt18 at z = +3.59
before.status: Descriptive only (owner retained 2026-09-22, decision 30, as a block, to revisit)
before.limitations: High and transferable. Reducing a locus of fifteen to forty peaks to one bit discards almost all of its information, and the null spread then swamps effects that are really there

after.claim: The graded locus statistic passes two recorded positive-control comparisons that the binary version did not
after.analysis: trial A1c against A1b: the binary form detected nothing anywhere, while the graded form clears on Etv5 against Abca3 at z = +3.55 and on Krt8 against Krt18 at z = +3.59
after.limitations: This is a within-trial method comparison. Passing selected positive controls does not establish calibrated sensitivity to all biological co-accessibility or rescue failed controls in the target wells. Prior block retention remains in decision 30.

before.claim: GSE150957, a bulk array of Wnt-sorted distal lung epithelium with a paired within-animal design and the mouse as the unit, can contribute to the Axin2 and Il1r1 joint question
before.analysis: this folder proposed it as Route C and the owner pointed out it is out of focus. Bulk cannot answer a co-occurrence question at any level of replication, because the question is whether two markers sit in the same cell and a sorted fraction reports an average; it also sorts on a Wnt activity reporter rather than Axin2, is whole distal epithelium rather than AT2, and uses a fifth injury model
before.status: Refuted (owner retained 2026-09-22, decision 30, as a block, to revisit)
before.limitations: High as a ranking error worth naming: the route was listed because it had the mouse as its unit, which is a virtue of its statistics and not of its relevance. Replication of a measurement that cannot address the question is worth very little

after.claim: Bulk Wnt-sorted GSE150957 measurements can directly resolve current Axin2/Il1r1 same-cell co-occurrence
after.analysis: this folder proposed it as Route C and the owner pointed out it is out of focus. Bulk cannot answer a co-occurrence question at any level of replication, because the question is whether two markers sit in the same cell and a sorted fraction reports an average; it also sorts on a Wnt activity reporter rather than Axin2, is whole distal epithelium rather than AT2, and uses a fifth injury model
after.limitations: The measurement does not identify same-cell co-occurrence, regardless of mouse replication. It can inform a different sorted-population association question; that possible use is not refuted. Prior block retention remains in decision 30.

before.claim: A number quoted in the register but never computed by a logged run is a wrong number
before.analysis: the audit distinguishes them, and so does this repository's own rule that a result with no logged artefact is Not established. Of the four unlogged numbers, the Sox9 ratio recomputes to 7.05 and was right; the C127 figures came from an adversarial agent and cannot be reproduced here at all
before.status: Descriptive only (owner retained 2026-09-22, decision 30, as a block, to revisit)
before.limitations: High as the distinction the correction turned on. An unlogged number that happens to be right is still Not established at the moment it is quoted, because nothing in the repository could have caught it if it were wrong, and in three of the four cases nothing did

after.claim: A number without a traceable logged computation is not established as a repository result, even when it happens to be numerically correct
after.analysis: the audit distinguishes them, and so does this repository's own rule that a result with no logged artefact is Not established. Of the four unlogged numbers, the Sox9 ratio recomputes to 7.05 and was right; the C127 figures came from an adversarial agent and cannot be reproduced here at all
after.limitations: High as the distinction the correction turned on. An unlogged number that happens to be right is still Not established at the moment it is quoted, because nothing in the repository could have caught it if it were wrong, and in three of the four cases nothing did This corrects the internal contradiction in the previous proposition that an unlogged number must be wrong. Decision 30 records the earlier block retention.

before.claim: Route B's transitional cell set was reported
before.analysis: trial A1c, produced and never registered until the audit found it missing: in the one transitional set large enough to compute, 773 cells of the infected Cebpa mutant, the Axin2 against Il1r1 correlation flips positive at r = +0.070 and the Wnt module at +0.092, percentile 0.94 and 0.977, against negative values in every AT2 set
before.status: Not established (owner retained 2026-09-22, decision 30, as a block, to revisit)
before.limitations: Moderate. Neither clears, the well is unreadable because its gate failed, and a difference between cell states is exactly what an underpowered design invents. It is registered because an unregistered result is invisible to every downstream reader, and because a later pass must not be able to present it as new

after.claim: The Axin2–Il1r1 and Wnt-module association differs between transitional cells and AT2 cells
after.analysis: trial A1c, produced and never registered until the audit found it missing: in the one transitional set large enough to compute, 773 cells of the infected Cebpa mutant, the Axin2 against Il1r1 correlation flips positive at r = +0.070 and the Wnt module at +0.092, percentile 0.94 and 0.977, against negative values in every AT2 set
after.limitations: Moderate. Neither clears, the well is unreadable because its gate failed, and a difference between cell states is exactly what an underpowered design invents. It is registered because an unregistered result is invisible to every downstream reader, and because a later pass must not be able to present it as new The positive correlations in one infected Cebpa-mutant transitional set are descriptive readings from a failed gate; they do not establish a replicated state interaction. This replaces the bookkeeping proposition without promoting the result. Decision 30 records the earlier block retention.

before.claim: The G2M-checkpoint positive control of trial G1 fails in both compartments, so the pooled active-repair arm is not more proliferative than injury resolution in the per-animal pseudobulk
before.analysis: trial G1 (GSE262927, 8 against 12 animals): HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT NES 0.40 (FDR 1.00) in myeloid and 1.15 (FDR 0.25) in capillary; trial N1's per-animal cycling fractions show no early peak in either lineage, so the expectation was wrong for this deposit, not the ranking
before.limitations: Moderate: it is the reason G1b exists, and it says that a proliferation gate imported from the source paper's phase narrative does not hold in these compartments' pseudobulks. The two measure different moments: the phases of C9 are read from the Ki67 trace, which records cycling during the tamoxifen window (myeloid peak 6 dpi), while the gate reads cycling at sacrifice, where the per-animal cycling fraction peaks at 25 dpi in myeloid and 19 dpi in endothelium (`phase_timecourse/tables/proliferation_peak_by_lineage.csv`)

after.claim: The G2M-checkpoint positive-control criterion of G1 was not met in either compartment
after.analysis: trial G1 (GSE262927, 8 against 12 animals): HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT NES 0.40 (FDR 1.00) in myeloid and 1.15 (FDR 0.25) in capillary; trial N1's per-animal cycling fractions show no early peak in either lineage, so the expectation was wrong for this deposit, not the ranking
after.limitations: The specified positive-control enrichment criterion was not met. This does not demonstrate equivalent proliferation or absence of an increase. The sample and gene-set null limitations remain. Prior owner retention is preserved in decision 28.

before.claim: DNA-replication programmes in the myeloid compartment are still higher at 42 and 90 dpi than at a year
before.analysis: trial G1 TEST contrast, injury resolution (12 animals) against long-term (3): 8 GO biological process sets at gseapy FDR < 0.05, of which 2 also clear the expression-matched null (GOBP_MITOTIC_DNA_REPLICATION NES 2.98, FDR 0.000, matched p 0.000; GOBP_CELL_CYCLE_DNA_REPLICATION NES 2.67, FDR 0.000, matched p 0.004); no hallmark set clears
before.limitations: Moderate: it agrees in direction with C13 (interstitial macrophages rising through 90 dpi) and with the aMAC rebuild, but three animals at 366 dpi cannot carry more than a direction; readable only through G1b's gate. Both nulls sample genes rather than animals, so the FDRs are optimistic (as in C161), and a proliferating subset growing in share (C13) would move the pseudobulk, so composition is not excluded. The same direction in human IPF macrophages (E2F, G2M and DNA replication sets in C161) makes persistent macrophage proliferation a cross-species lead, not evidence

after.claim: DNA-replication programmes in the myeloid compartment are higher at 42 and 90 dpi than at a year
after.analysis: trial G1 TEST contrast, injury resolution (12 animals) against long-term (3): 8 GO biological process sets at gseapy FDR < 0.05, of which 2 also clear the expression-matched null (GOBP_MITOTIC_DNA_REPLICATION NES 2.98, FDR 0.000, matched p 0.000; GOBP_CELL_CYCLE_DNA_REPLICATION NES 2.67, FDR 0.000, matched p 0.004); no hallmark set clears Post-audit reference CAMERA: neither DNA-replication set passes confound-aware sensitivities under estimated correlation or fixed 0.01; fixed 0.01 supports the unadjusted contrast only.
after.limitations: The legacy GSEA direction remains a historical observation. Reference voom/TMM plus estimated-correlation CAMERA does not establish the programme contrast under the corrected family; adjusted and restricted sensitivities also fail. Resolution has 12 animals (3 female, 9 male; 4 homozygotes); long-term has 3 (2 female, 1 male; no homozygotes), all from the December 2022 round. Adding collection day makes the design rank deficient. Injury time cannot be separated from ageing; aMAC results do not validate whole-myeloid inference. Prior owner retention is preserved in decision 28.

before.claim: Gene set programmes whose donor-level direction, IPF against control within a compartment, replicates in a held-out cohort
before.analysis: trial G2: discovery GSE136831 (AT2 3 against 10, fibroblasts 18 against 4, macrophages 32 against 27 donors), held out GSE135893 (AT2 8 against 6, fibroblasts 7 against 3, macrophages 12 against 9); 254 discovery sets cleared both nulls, 62 replicated in the same direction in the same compartment (AT2: 9 cleared, 8 replicated; fibroblasts: 24 cleared, 3 replicated; macrophages: 221 cleared, 51 replicated); replicated sets by discovery FDR: HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1 (macrophages, NES 3.60 then 1.95); HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V2 (macrophages, NES 3.08 then 1.70); HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT (macrophages, NES 2.59 then 2.31); HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION (macrophages, NES 2.70 then 2.21); HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS (macrophages, NES 3.83 then 2.48); HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION (fibroblasts, NES 2.10 then 1.62)
before.limitations: High for the replicated sets: donor as the unit, pre-registered gene sets, two nulls and a held-out cohort; the non-replicating sets are Not established whatever their discovery FDR. What is validated is the direction of each set at the donor level, not a biological reading of it. Three limits stated: the AT2 discovery arm sits at the three-donor floor because IPF depletes AT2 cells; a compartment pseudobulk reads composition and state together, so the macrophage sets (every one up in IPF) do not separate monocyte-derived influx or proliferating macrophages from a change in resident cells; and both discovery nulls sample genes rather than donors, so they ignore inter-gene correlation and the discovery FDRs are optimistic (Wu and Smyth 2012, doi:10.1093/nar/gks461), while held-out replication guards against chance but not against an artefact both cohorts share. The eight AT2 sets are the weakest for that reason: they are mesenchymal and immune programmes (coagulation, complement, myogenesis, allograft rejection) that ambient RNA from fibrotic tissue would also produce in a low-count pseudobulk. The fibroblast EMT set is the trial's positive control, not a discovery

after.claim: IPF-control compartment programme directions have cross-cohort support that depends strongly on the gene-set correlation model
after.analysis: trial G2: discovery GSE136831 (AT2 3 against 10, fibroblasts 18 against 4, macrophages 32 against 27 donors), held out GSE135893 (AT2 8 against 6, fibroblasts 7 against 3, macrophages 12 against 9); 254 discovery sets cleared both nulls, 62 replicated in the same direction in the same compartment (AT2: 9 cleared, 8 replicated; fibroblasts: 24 cleared, 3 replicated; macrophages: 221 cleared, 51 replicated); replicated sets by discovery FDR: HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1 (macrophages, NES 3.60 then 1.95); HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V2 (macrophages, NES 3.08 then 1.70); HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT (macrophages, NES 2.59 then 2.31); HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION (macrophages, NES 2.70 then 2.21); HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS (macrophages, NES 3.83 then 2.48); HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION (fibroblasts, NES 2.10 then 1.62) Post-audit reference CAMERA: 0 two-cohort candidates with estimated residual correlation; 30 with fixed correlation 0.01 (1 AT2, 1 fibroblast, 28 macrophage), 28 of them among the legacy 62.
after.limitations: Reclassified from Validated. Both original cohorts used a gene-permutation null, so correlation-related calibration limits apply to both. Official voom/TMM plus CAMERA yields zero corrected two-cohort candidates with estimated residual correlation, but 30 with fixed correlation 0.01 (1 AT2, 1 fibroblast, 28 macrophage), of which 28 overlap the historical 62. Neither setting is selected because it gives more hits: the primary estimated-correlation specification remains primary, the fixed setting is a declared sensitivity. Directional leads remain exploratory and method-sensitive, not robustly validated or biologically absent. Subtype, ambient-RNA, floor-selection and observational-design limits remain; overlapping sets are not independent mechanisms. Prior owner retention is preserved in decision 28.

before.claim: In late active repair (11 to 25 dpi) the alveolar macrophage population carries a complement, Trem2 and response-state programme that it no longer carries at 42 and 90 dpi
before.analysis: trial W1 contrast A, aMAC pseudobulk per animal, 4 against 8 animals, pydeseq2 ~ batch + sex + arm: 310 genes at padj < 0.05, 217 up in late active repair, led by C1qb and C1qc (log2 fold change 5.68 and 5.59), Trem2 (1.29), Tnf (0.97), Mmp14, Slc7a11 and the response-state genes Oas3, Oasl2, Slfn5 and Tap1; proliferation genes do not differ (Mki67 padj 0.55)
before.limitations: Moderate: the profile of a pool still being rebuilt from monocytes, which agrees with the trace dating of C15 at the gene level. The deposited aMAC label may include monocyte-derived cells that have not finished converting, so a large C1q fold change can be composition inside the label as well as state; one deposit, one arm of four animals

before.claim: A pre-registered proliferation or arginine and ornithine gene set separates the alveolar macrophage population between repair phases
before.analysis: trial W1 under CAMERA on the same design: no set at FDR < 0.05 in either contrast (0.95 in late active repair against resolution, 0.46 to 0.48 in resolution against long-term); the proliferation sets carry an inter-gene correlation of 0.30 to 0.45 across animals, and the two hallmark sets a variance inflation of 55 to 69, so a hallmark set of about 190 genes carries the independent information of about three; the ornithine set had 7 genes and was not tested
before.limitations: Moderate, for the method more than the biology: an absence at these arms bounds nothing (rule R9), but the correlation it measured is the reason a gene-permutation null, as used for C158 and discovery in C161, can report FDR 0.000 for a proliferation set. Whether C158 survives a correlation-respecting test on its own myeloid pseudobulk is untested

after.claim: A pre-registered proliferation or arginine and ornithine gene set separates the alveolar macrophage population between repair phases
after.analysis: trial W1 under CAMERA on the same design: no set at FDR < 0.05 in either contrast (0.95 in late active repair against resolution, 0.46 to 0.48 in resolution against long-term); the proliferation sets carry an inter-gene correlation of 0.30 to 0.45 across animals, and the two hallmark sets a variance inflation of 55 to 69, so a hallmark set of about 190 genes carries the independent information of about three; the ornithine set had 7 genes and was not tested Official reference limma CAMERA reproduces the no-hit result under both historical logCPM and voom/TMM transformations with estimated correlation.

Whether C158 survives a correlation-respecting test on its own myeloid pseudobulk is untested The original custom statistic is retained as historical. The undersized seven-gene ornithine set was not tested, and failed significance is not equivalence or absence of a circuit.

before.claim: Alveolar macrophages at a year carry more NF-kB and immediate-early transcripts than at 90 dpi
before.analysis: trial W1 contrast B, 8 against 3 animals, the arm identified inside infection round 2022-12-06: 100 genes at padj < 0.05, 71 higher at 366 dpi, led by Il1a, Tnf, Nfkbiz, Nfkbid, Ccrl2, Zfp36, S100a8 and Cd274; Mki67 alone is higher at 90 dpi (log2 fold change 1.19, padj 0.02)
before.limitations: Low as injury biology: the contrast is confounded with about nine months of age (ageing alone changes alveolar macrophages, McQuattie-Pimentel et al. 2021, doi:10.1172/JCI140299), with sex inside the round, and with harvest date, and Tnf, Il1a, Nfkbiz and Zfp36 are also dissociation-stress genes (van den Brink et al. 2017, reference M8). Nothing here separates persistence after injury from age or processing

after.claim: The ADI published-marker contrast of the two-transcript-labelled group depends on developmental and injury context in the examined control wells
after.analysis: ES1 at 2,000 RNA UMI, label-free published ADI list: P9 control +1.04/+1.21 detection points; adult SeV control +7.61/+6.53 across seeds 17/29. All 400 source markers retained before exclusion of label genes; 398 remain and 390 are present in the multiome universe
after.limitations: A within-well conditional contrast, one pooled library per condition. Higher absolute neonatal scores and a smaller labelled-reference difference are compatible. This does not establish a developmental mechanism, injury specificity, full DATP/PATS equivalence or fate.

after.claim: ES1 has replicated external biological confirmation under the frozen two-group eligibility rule
after.analysis: GSE262927: 25 animals examined, only EEM-scRNA-167 qualifies in both seeds (40/193 and 35/197 labelled/reference cells); ADI contrasts +12.64/+11.58 detection points. The 7-week multiome control also crosses its floor between seeds (30 versus 26 labelled cells)
after.limitations: The external study was already analyzed by this repository and lacks a neonatal arm. One eligible mouse provides a consistency observation, not replicated confirmation. Failure of a cell floor is not biological absence.

after.claim: The published AT2-marker labelled-reference contrast is smaller in the sampled Cebpa-mutant wells than in controls at the same stage
after.analysis: ES1 label-free AT2 list: P9 controls -4.59/-4.79 detection points versus mutants -0.70/-0.31; injured adult controls -8.88/-7.34 versus mutants -2.28/-2.43. Reference scores are also lower in mutants
after.limitations: One well per genotype/stage and reference selection on Sftpc prevent an inferred genotype-by-state interaction. This motivates testing whether baseline reference shifts or labelled-cell changes explain the contrast, with animal replication and independent state definitions.

after.claim: Broad ADI and AT1 marker scores are not independent evidence for transitional identity and mature AT1 fate
after.analysis: The source-derived ADI and AT1 holdout lists share 119 genes; the four-gene late-AT1 panel changes direction across technical seeds in several injured wells and the one eligible external mouse
after.limitations: Shared membership is an arithmetic dependence, not proof that shared genes cause transition. Split shared and AT1-unique components and compare with independent late-maturation endpoints before reading an AT1 score as fate.
